description: Query DSL, sorting, paging, highlighting, aggregations and collapse on one shard

query_string.query: title:(quick OR lazy) AND NOT cat:life

details.description: score(freq=1.0), computed as boost * idf * tf from:
idf, computed as log(1 + (N - n + 0.5) / (n + 0.5)) from:
n, number of documents containing term
N, total number of documents with field
tf, computed as freq / (freq + k1 * (1 - b + b * dl / avgdl)) from:
freq, occurrences of term within document

root_cause.reason: Fielddata is disabled on [title] in [es-docs-s]. Text fields are not optimised for operations that require per-document field data like aggregations and sorting, so these operations are disabled by default. Please use a keyword field instead. Alternatively, set fielddata=true on [title] in order to load field data by uninverting the inverted index. Note that this can use significant memory.
